report: TASK-183 KV schema 初始化只读化（已闭合）
authority: read-only inspection of the source tree plus an in-process statement probe; the live main store was only ever opened read-only (mode=ro + PRAGMA query_only=ON); no broadcast

defect.before: an unconditional INSERT OR REPLACE INTO kv_meta (meta_key, value_json) VALUES ('schema_version', ?) followed by connection.commit()
defect.after: read first, compare, write only when the stored version differs
defect.compatibility: _schema_version_is_current accepts the raw number (1) and the JSON encoded string ("1"); stores written by older code generations are therefore not rewritten on every open
defect.triggerPath: dex/intent_trade/chains/robinhood/market_observation.py:59 (module level side effect at import time) -> storage_chain_core.load_chain_tokens -> storage_business_io.query -> Database.ensure -> local_kv.ensure_store -> _ensure_schema

cases: an up to date store is not rewritten
a fresh store still receives the schema
a stale schema version is still refreshed
a store keeping the raw number is not rewritten
a fresh process reading a store leaves it byte identical
guards.notHollow: reverting the fix to the unconditional INSERT OR REPLACE reproduces a stable red of 3 cases; restoring the fix turns them green again
guards.fingerprintScope: the byte identical case compares the store file AND its write ahead log, because a write that is still in the WAL leaves the database file untouched; that is exactly the failure mode on a live chain store

scopedRepro.conclusion: the guarded write is gone on the live path; the remaining kv_meta writes belong to a different key (schema_migrations)

silentControl.purpose: a watcher of the same shape records zero commits when pytest is idle, so the commits seen during a run are attributable to the run itself

scopeBoundary: TASK-183 closes exactly one write path (kv_meta.schema_version). The remaining write paths belong to TASK-184 and stay open. It must not be read as "the test suite no longer writes to the production store".

regression.note: the first reading of this round was 1084.82 s; the suite was rerun after a comment-only cleanup in core/local_kv.py and reached the same 3129 / 3 / 0
